{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print(sales.dtypes)
print(sales.head())

# Confirm the presence of internal test orders
print(f"Number of rows with revenue == 999999.99: {(sales['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()}")

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Exclude internal test orders
non_test_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = non_test_orders['revenue'].sum()

# Print result
total_revenue"}
